Question Choices: A gardener plants 54 flowers in 6 hours. How many flowers can the gardener plant in 3 hours? Assume the same rate or price per item.
Hints: Find the constant unit rate, then multiply by the required number of units.
Solution: At the same rate, one unit gives 54÷6=9. For 3 units, multiply 9×3=27 flowers.
